newsitem.title: SHARJAH: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND DISMISS PAKISTAN CHEAPLY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND DISMISS PAKISTAN CHEAPLY.

text.p: A fired-up New Zealand bowled out Pakistan for a modest 160 in the Singer Champions' Trophy final on Friday.

New Zealand, despite being handicapped by the absence of their premier fast bowlers Danny Morrison and Simon Doull -- out because of a groin and hamstring injury respectively -- frustrated the Pakistan batsmen with a tidy line and length.

Pakistan, put in by New Zealand, lost the way the moment Justin Vaughan dismissed in-form batsman Saeed Anwar with the fifth delivery of the match. Reckless shots by top order batsmen further eased their task.
Salim Malik (40) and Azam Khan (22) finally steadied the innings with a 53-run stand for the fifth wicket and Moin Khan contributed a well-struck 32 off 44 balls with three sixes.
